desc: SUMMIT brings outstanding value to small kitchens with fully featured electric ranges in 24" wide fits. Made in North America, the RE2411W is a 220V electric range designed for 24" wide spaces.
hl: Broiler is located inside the oven, making it easier to use
Perfectly sized for apartments and smaller home kitchens
Lower compartment offers the perfect space-saving storage solution for pots and pans
Large window makes it easier to monitor your cooking
Interior light included for easy viewing
High backing prevents stovetop contents from splashing up or boiling over and staining back walls
